name: velocut-monorepo
description: VeloCut Hybrid-Edge Studio Architecture (V-HESA) — Zero-Cloud-Cost Web Video Editor

scripts.dev: concurrently -n WEB,API -c cyan,green "npm run dev:web" "npm run dev:server"
scripts.start: npm run build && npm --workspace=@velocut/server run start
scripts.build: npm --workspace=@velocut/shared run build && npm --workspace=@velocut/web run build && npm --workspace=@velocut/server run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --workspace=@velocut/shared run typecheck && npm --workspace=@velocut/web run typecheck && npm --workspace=@velocut/server run typecheck
scripts.test: npm --workspace=@velocut/web run test && npm --workspace=@velocut/server run test
